propositions: Bedrock must be measured against a parity bar before becoming a first-class provider in S8 cutover, using a harness modeled on the fidelity_spot_eval precedent with the same epoch-majority aggregation and committed-results shape.

The probe (Step 1) confirms both Bedrock inference-profile ids (sonnet-4-6 and opus-4-8) are invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1, with temperature=0 refused only on opus as expected by the supports_temperature override.

Payload and tool parity hold across both class slots: system prompt, messages, max_tokens and temperature are byte-identical between Anthropic and Bedrock arms; six tools are identical in name, description and schema; provider routing is clean with zero non-Bedrock calls on the v2 arm.

The live paired corpus run (30 cases, 3 epochs per arm per slot, both slots measurable) shows Bedrock structured-output validity at 1.000 with zero runtime errors and latency at or better than direct Anthropic, satisfying the in-scope criteria of payload/tool/capability parity and provider-clean routing.
